name: Old Web
summary: The aesthetic is characterized by its technical rawness and maximalist use of animated elements, reflecting a time before standardized, mobile-friendly design.
description: The aesthetic is characterized by its technical rawness and maximalist use of animated elements, reflecting a time before standardized, mobile-friendly design. It celebrates the period when the internet was primarily a space for individual expression, predating the rise of corporate social media platforms.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Decentralization, amateur creativity, community building, nostalgia, technological novelty

visualDNA.colour: Web-safe palette (vibrant primary and secondary colors), neon text, underlined blue hyperlinks
